body:
# Sarah Thornburg

# Chair of the Board

![](/media/uploads/2026/07/Sarah-Thornburg.png)

- In a [news questionnaire](https://web.archive.org/web/20250902045411/https:/mountainx.com/news/2022-general-voter-guide-asheville-city-board-of-education/) about what qualities she will seek in a new superintendent, she said she wants a central office that nurtures students in “mind, body, and spirit.”
- [She said](https://web.archive.org/web/20250902045411/https:/mountainx.com/news/2022-general-voter-guide-asheville-city-board-of-education/) the district should prioritize teacher recruitment that reflects “the diversity of their classrooms.”
- After the Parents Bill of Rights (state law) was passed to prohibit teaching about sexuality and gender identity in elementary schools, [Thornburg said](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/99df48d7-0634-49f9-8527-cf4febe868c3/Thornburg-quote-about-PBR.png), “we’re all struggling with this” and “At the heart of it, it’s bad policy and we all hope and pray it will be overturned in the courts or elsewhere.”
